code_python3:
class Solution:
    def boundaryOfBinaryTree(self, root):
        if not root: return []
        res = [root.val]
        def lb(n):
            if not n or (not n.left and not n.right): return
            res.append(n.val)
            lb(n.left if n.left else n.right)
        def lv(n):
            if not n: return
            if not n.left and not n.right: res.append(n.val); return
            lv(n.left); lv(n.right)
        def rb(n):
            if not n or (not n.left and not n.right): return
            rb(n.right if n.right else n.left)
            res.append(n.val)
        lb(root.left); lv(root.left); lv(root.right); rb(root.right)
        return res

title: Longest Line of Consecutive One in Matrix
key_insight: 四个方向分别DP记录连续1长度
approach:
1. dp[i][j][4方向]
2. 取全局最大
code_python3:
class Solution:
    def longestLine(self, mat) -> int:
        if not mat: return 0
        m,n=len(mat),len(mat[0])
        dp=[[[0]*4 for _ in range(n)] for _ in range(m)]
        ans=0
        for i in range(m):
            for j in range(n):
                if mat[i][j]==0: continue
                dp[i][j]=[1]*4
                if j>0: dp[i][j][0]=dp[i][j-1][0]+1
                if i>0: dp[i][j][1]=dp[i-1][j][1]+1
                if i>0 and j>0: dp[i][j][2]=dp[i-1][j-1][2]+1
                if i>0 and j<n-1: dp[i][j][3]=dp[i-1][j+1][3]+1
                ans=max(ans,max(dp[i][j]))
        return ans

1. 正则提取分数
2. 通分计算

code_python3:
class Solution:
    def fractionAddition(self, expression: str) -> str:
        import re
        from math import gcd
        nums = re.findall(r'[+-]?\d+', expression)
        A, B = 0, 1
        for i in range(0, len(nums), 2):
            a, b = int(nums[i]), int(nums[i+1])
            A = A*b + a*B
            B *= b
            g = gcd(abs(A), B)
            A //= g; B //= g
        return f'{A}/{B}'

title: Non-negative Integers without Consecutive Ones
key_insight: 数位DP统计不含连续1的二进制数
approach:
1. 预计算fib
2. 从高位逐位判断
code_python3:
class Solution:
    def findIntegers(self, n: int) -> int:
        bits=bin(n)[2:]
        k=len(bits)
        fib=[0]*(k+2)
        fib[0]=fib[1]=1
        for i in range(2,k+2): fib[i]=fib[i-1]+fib[i-2]
        ans=0; prev=0
        for i in range(k):
            if bits[i]=='1':
                ans+=fib[k-i-1+1]
                if prev: return ans
                prev=1
            else: prev=0
        return ans+1
